top_20_records_by_obligation.transaction_description: APPLICATION FOR IMMUNIZATION AND VFC COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT FOR SUPPLEMENTAL FUNDING TO SUPPORT IMMUNIZATION SYSTEMS AND TO SUPPORT ADMINISTRATION OF VACCINE TO RECENTLY DISPLACED UKRAINIANS RESETTLED. - IN JULY 2022, DOH ANNOUNCED A CASE OF PARALYTIC POLIOVIRUS DISEASE IN A RESIDENT OF ROCKLAND COUNTY WHO HAD NOT RECENTLY TRAVELED OVERSEAS. BECAUSE PARALYSIS IS AN INFREQUENT OUTCOME OF INFECTION IN UNVACCINATED PEOPLE, THIS IMPLIES HUNDREDS OR THOUSANDS OF OTHER PERSONS WERE INFECTED AND TRANSMITTING THE VIRUS (VDPV-2) IN THE COMMUNITY. SUBSEQUENTLY, THERE WERE REPEATED DETECTIONS OF POLIOVIRUS IN WASTEWATER FROM ROCKLAND, ORANGE, AND SULLIVAN COUNTIES, INCLUDING SAMPLES TESTED FROM APRIL TO NOVEMBER 2022. THE DOH RESPONSE HAS INVOLVED PROVIDER AND PATIENT OUTREACH ACTIVITIES FOCUSED ON CHILDREN WHO ARE NOT UP TO DATE ON POLIO VACCINATION. THIS EFFORT HAS INVOLVED SHORT-TERM DEPLOYERS FROM CDC AND TEMPORARILY SHIFTING REGIONAL DOH STAFF TO THESE ACTIVITIES BUT IS NOT SUSTAINABLE BEYOND A FEW ADDITIONAL MONTHS. YEARS OF MISINFORMATION AND VACCINE HESITANCY HAVE BUILT-UP IN THE AFFECTED COMMUNITIES, WHICH EXPERIENCE OUTBREAKS OF VACCINE-PREVENTABLE DISEASES (VPD) EVERY FEW YEARS (E.G., MEASLES IN 2018, PERTUSSIS, VARICELLA). ACCORDINGLY, SUSTAINED ATTENTION OVER MONTHS AND YEARS IS NEEDED TO CHANGE ATTITUDES AND BEHAVIORS TO HAVE LASTING PUBLIC HEALTH IMPACT AND END THIS ONGOING EMERGENCY CYCLE. A CORE ACTIVITY OF THE POLIO RESPONSE THUS FAR HAS BEEN WORKING WITH PROVIDERS TO SEND RECALL LETTERS TO CHILDREN < 5 YEARS IDENTIFIED IN THE STATE IMMUNIZATION SYSTEM (NYSIIS) AS HAVING INITIATED IPV BUT HAVE NOT COMPLETED THE SERIES. EVALUATION EFFORTS ESTIMATE THAT ABOUT 20% OF CHILDREN RECEIVED DOSES FOLLOWING RECALL LETTERS. FOR THE REMAINING 80%, ADDITIONAL OUTREACH BEYOND THE INITIAL LETTERS WILL BE NEEDED TO INCREASE IMMUNIZATIONS, WHICH MAY PROVIDE ADDITIONAL INFORMATION, CONVERSATION TO UNDERSTAND AND ADDRESS HESITANCY AND OTHER REASONS FOR VACCINE NON-RECEIPT, AND TO HELP TROUBLESHOOT BARRIERS IDENTIFIED BY FAMILIES. SUCH OUTREACH WILL BE MOST SUCCESSFUL IF DELIVERED BY TRUSTED WORKERS FROM THE COMMUNITIES. THE REQUESTED FUNDS WILL SUPPORT A PILOT OF AN INDIVIDUAL-LEVEL OUTREACH PROGRAM TO SUCCEED THE PROVIDER RECALL LETTERS AND REACH CHILDREN STILL IN NEED, AT A DEEPER LEVEL OF ENGAGEMENT THAN LETTERS AFFORD. THE PROGRAM WILL INVOLVE A COMBINATION OF TRAINED COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKERS AND HEALTHCARE STAFF POSITIONED AT A LOCAL ORGANIZATION IN ORANGE COUNTY (10950). A DATA-TO-ACTION (AKA: DATA-TO-CARE) MODEL WOULD BE ADAPTED TO IDENTIFY A COHORT OF FAMILIES WHOSE CHILDREN NEED DOSES (SEGMENTED INTO INFORMATIVE AGE, DOSE, AND GEOGRAPHIC STRATA AND PRIORITIZATION) AND THEN HAVE OUTREACH WORKERS CONTACT THOSE FAMILIES VIA PHONE AND BY HOME VISIT TO ASSESS THE REASONS FOR VACCINE NON-RECEIPT. EVIDENCE-BASED APPROACHES WOULD BE USED TO BUILD RELATIONSHIPS AND ADDRESS CONCERNS OR MISINFORMATION ABOUT VACCINES AND POLIO. SHOULD BARRIERS SPECIFIC TO ACCESS BE IDENTIFIED, PARTICULARLY TRANSPORTATION, THE PROGRAM WILL INCLUDE OPTIONS TO ADDRESS THIS. OUTREACH WORKERS WOULD USE A CASE MANAGEMENT APPROACH TO MAINTAIN A PATIENT LOAD WHOSE ISSUES THEY SEEK TO ADDRESS TO ENSURE FAMILIES CHOOSE TO HAVE THEIR CHILDREN VACCINATED. ORANGE COUNTY CONTAINS THE 10950 ZIP CODE, WHICH HAS THE LARGEST TOTAL NUMBER OF CHILDREN WHO ARE NOT UP-TO-DATE ON THEIR POLIO VACCINATIONS, OVER 10,000, AND THE LOWEST COUNTY-LEVEL RATE OF IPV COVERAGE BY 2 YEARS AMONG COUNTIES THAT HAVE BEEN INVOLVED IN THE CURRENT POLIO OUTBREAK. ADDITIONALLY, FAMILIES IN 10950 ARE CLUSTERED IN A MORE CONCENTRATED GEOGRAPHIC AREA, WHICH IS BENEFICIAL FOR SCHEDULING HOME VISITS, AND ARE LIKEWISE CLUSTERED INTO A SMALLER NUMBER OF HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS. SITUATING THIS PILOT IN ORANGE ALLOWS FOR MORE EQUITABLE DISTRIBUTION OF LIMITED FEDERAL RESOURCES, FOCUSING ON A LESSER-SERVED AREA OF GREATEST NEED AND WITH HIGH LIKELIHOOD OF SUCCESS. NYSDOH HOPES TO EXPAND THIS EFFORT TO ALL IMPACTED COUNTIES AFTER THE PILOT PHASE IN ORANGE IS EVALUATED.
